originalMethod.target: The same original advanced pawn forces a material-costly interception, or converts by promotion after the defender skips that interception. Both axes may be independently supported.

candidates.repeated: Same pawn, square and cost in paired and independent branch windows with a better choice avoiding it.
candidates.restricted: Repeated plus exact checkpoint corroboration via best taking and best non-taking replies at 1200000 nodes each. Trace the same pawn through promotion or eventual costly interception.

originalMethod.gate: Two or more newly supported held-out tactical diagnoses including at least one classical game, no contradicted additions, no synthetic promotion of the positional axis, no extra checks for unrelated decisions. If the added search offers no robust gain over the existing frames, keep it offline.
originalMethod.scoring: Single reviewer uses independent 2400000-node reply searches and 1650000-node restricted searches. Uncertain cases excluded from binary denominators.

causalRevision.development: A better-line witness is needed because LNC1C and JVWeJ allow the same costly liquidation in a deeper control.

variants.cheapDefence: Repeated and both stronger paths capture the same original pawn without material loss (same-square exchange and next reply). No extra Stockfish search.
variants.bothChoices: The same stronger-move check plus the original two restricted searches.

causalRevision.reserve: Untouched puzzle slice after row 2,410,000. Original first-puzzle labels used for analysis of the false positives.

review: One reviewer inspected legally replayed paired lines, an independent 2400000-node reply and a 1650000-node restricted defence. These are scoped adjudications. They are not exhaustive solutions.
